parent_objective: audit no-rollout off-track localization before repair design
blocked_by: need localization audit before task-quality repair design

public_gates: M1719 must audit M1718 localization counts and guardrails
M1719 must decide whether off-track dominance is localized enough for repair design or diffuse enough for source-distribution redesign
M1719 must keep profile rows as controls rather than ranking evidence
M1719 must not run rollout train replay PPO promote use private holdout or change actor inputs
M1719 must not claim controller-family ranking, paper-level evidence, or level3 self-ID

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether M1718 localization supports repair target design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: no-rollout public diagnostic audit only; no training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if localization artifacts are missing
stop if repair target slices are empty
stop if localization is profile-ranking biased
stop if route decision is not explicit
fallback_plan: route to artifact repair if localization artifacts are incomplete
route to task-quality repair design if targets are localized
route to source-distribution redesign if targets are diffuse

admission_evidence: M1718 materialized no-rollout repair target slices
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1719 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up repair design or source redesign manifest

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1719 audits task-quality localization and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audit must not treat profile differences as recurrent advantage or history necessity
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1718 public diagnostic localization artifacts only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If localization is diffuse, route to source-distribution redesign rather than weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1718 localization can be audited to decide whether off-track dominance is localized enough to design a repaired task-quality panel.
success_criteria: M1718 result_class and guardrails are audited
profile rows remain controls rather than ranking evidence
rollout execution training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit omits M1718 result and guardrails
audit routes directly to rollout or training
environment rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur
decision_rule: M1719 passes if it audits localization and routes to task-quality repair design, source-distribution redesign, or artifact repair without overclaiming.
